alignments.note: νυνί → *now*. The variant unit SBLGNT.HEB.8.6.v005 is underdetermined and the projection's reading is realized here, so rule 97 is not in play.
τέτυχεν → *hath he obtained*, headed on the lexical verb under rule 9.
Anarthrous λειτουργίας with a supplied *a*, a rule 7 helper under rule 51's anarthrous clause.

The ASV postposes the comparative as *the more excellent*, so the supplied *the* stands with the adjective phrase rather than with the noun, which has already taken its own *a*. Rule 58's noun-carrier clause is the competing reading, but it presupposes a single determiner for the phrase, and here the ASV wrote two.
Dative of measure ὅσῳ → *by so much as*, one unit. Rule 104 heads a degree correlative on the dimension word, *much*.
ἐστιν → *he is*, headed on the verb.
Intensifying καί → *also* under rule 65's English-side test.
Anarthrous μεσίτης with a supplied *the*, a rule 7 helper on the noun under rule 51's anarthrous clause.
Both adjective and noun are anarthrous, so rule 58 gives the supplied determiner to the noun along with the case preposition, *of a … covenant* discontinuous under rule 15.
κρείττονος → *better*, a bare modifier under rule 58.
νενομοθέτηται → *hath been enacted*, headed on the lexical participle under rule 9.

review_notes: The ASV writes two determiners in *a ministry the more excellent*; *a* goes to the noun and *the* to the postposed comparative, with the rule 58 alternative named in the note.
ὅσῳ takes the whole *by so much as* frame, headed on *much* under rule 104.
